entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Billing' to be routed to the correct department.
Support!
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and email address?
Mark Peterson. M-peterson@example.com. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! I ordered a large and it feels like a small. It's way too tight, I can barely get it on. I need an exchange or my money back immediately.
I understand your frustration with the fit. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see the jersey was delivered to you 63 days ago.

And? Your policy says 90 days! I've already checked! If you try to deny this I'm going to file a chargeback and I'll make sure every cycling forum online knows how you treat customers. This is garbage! Get me your manager!
Sir, there's no need for that, I can definitely help you. Please allow me one moment to confirm the policy details for this item.
Unbelievable. Fine. You have sixty seconds before I hang up and blast you on social media.
Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've reviewed the policy, and you are absolutely correct. Our standard return window is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe to make a return.
Damn right I am. So what are you going to do about it?

I'm processing the return authorization for you right now. I can set this up as a full refund to your original payment method, or if you'd prefer, I can process an exchange for a larger size. Which would you like to do?
Fine. Just... just send me the refund. I'm done with this. I'll buy from someone else. Send me the return label.

Of course. I have just initiated that refund process. A pre-paid return label has been sent to your email on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed.
Whatever. Just make sure it works.
It will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
